developmentVelocity.justification: Monolith required in-memory boundary method calls and unified transaction handling. Microservices required network payload schemas, distributed compensating Saga transactions, multiple Dockerfile updates, API Gateway proxy rules, and distributed expiry sweeper sync.

boundaryHops.monolith: In-process function calls (direct stack invocation, 0 network serialization)
boundaryHops.microservices: HTTP/REST network hops via API Gateway and inter-service axios calls

testingOverhead.notes: Microservices testing requires cluster spin-up, TCP socket handshakes, JSON serialization over loopback, and distributed timing coordination.
